rendered:
In the passive-targeting rows of Table 2[1], several systems have a particle size of at least the threshold. The KRAS TGF-β system is at ~180 nm[2] (ref. [69][3]). The VEGFR2 siRNA/mTOR sEVs system is at ~150 nm[4] (ref. [80][5]). The siTEAD4 MOF@EVs system is at ~168 nm[6] (ref. [82][7]). The DDP/VEGF MOF system is at ~485 nm[8] (ref. [103][9]).

The largest of these is the DDP/VEGF MOF system, at about ~485 nm[10]. The remaining passive systems are smaller or have no size listed (the TUBB2B siRNA-AuNP entry has a dash).
